title: sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow
description: Heap buffer overflow in sudo when unescaping backslashes in command arguments.
fix_pattern: Replace strcpy with strlcpy + explicit bounds check before copy

title: libmodbus Heap Buffer Overflow
description: Out-of-bounds write when processing malformed Modbus requests.
fix_pattern: Bounds check before memcpy using destination capacity

title: nginx Range Filter Integer Overflow
description: Integer overflow leads to heap buffer overflow in Range header parsing.
fix_pattern: Validate allocation size before heap allocation

title: OpenSSL Heartbleed
description: Missing bounds check on heartbeat payload length exposes heap memory.
fix_pattern: Verify payload length against actual buffer before memcpy

title: glibc getaddrinfo Stack Buffer Overflow
description: Stack buffer overflow in DNS response parsing for dual A/AAAA records.
fix_pattern: Replace sprintf with snprintf and bound format output

title: OpenSSH scp Command Injection
description: Unsafe construction of remote command allows injection via filenames.
fix_pattern: Sanitize user-controlled path before shell command construction

title: cJSON Use-After-Free
description: Double-free style use-after-free when deleting nested objects.
fix_pattern: Nullify pointer after free to prevent use-after-free

title: curl MQTT Heap Overflow
description: Heap overflow when MQTT packet length exceeds allocated buffer.
fix_pattern: Bounds check before memcpy against destination buffer size

title: curl TFTP Buffer Overflow
description: Out-of-bounds write in TFTP receive path on malformed options.
fix_pattern: Replace strcpy with strlcpy using sizeof destination

title: OpenSSL Infinite Loop in BN_mod_sqrt
description: Infinite loop triggered by crafted certificate with invalid elliptic curve parameters.
patch:
- while (loop_cond) { ... }
+ for (i = 0; i < max_iter && loop_cond; i++) { ... }
fix_pattern: Add iteration bound to prevent non-terminating loop on malformed input

title: PHP gdImageRotate Stack Overflow
description: Stack buffer overflow when rotating images with crafted dimensions.
patch:
- sprintf(buf, fmt, angle);
+ snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, angle);
fix_pattern: Replace sprintf with snprintf and bound format output

title: libxml2 Heap Buffer Overflow
description: Heap overflow parsing entity names in XML documents.
fix_pattern: Validate remaining buffer space before memcpy
